units.source_text: 内大臣邸内，也传来了太政大臣访问三条邸的消息。

en.t: News also reached the Inner Minister's residence that the Chancellor had gone to visit the Sanjo mansion.

units.source_text: 内大臣吃惊地说：“太君那边人手稀少，招待这贵人很吃力吧。

en.t: The Inner Minister said in surprise, "The lady has so few attendants there; it must be very hard for her to receive such an honored guest.

units.source_text: 款待前驱人等，安排贵宾座位，恐怕都没有干练的人。

en.t: There is probably no one capable enough to entertain the advance attendants or arrange the guest's seat properly.

units.source_text: 夕雾中将想必也来的。”

en.t: Lieutenant General Yugiri must surely be coming as well."

units.source_text: 便派诸公子及平素亲近的殿上人等赴三条邸帮忙，吩咐道：“果物酒肴等，务须殷勤供奉，不可怠慢。

en.t: He therefore sent his sons and the courtiers who were usually close to him to the Sanjo mansion to help, instructing them, "Be sure to serve the fruit, wine, and dishes with the utmost care, and do not be negligent.

units.source_text: 我自己本应同去，深恐反而嘈杂，所以作罢。”

en.t: I myself ought to go with you, but I fear that my presence would only make things more troublesome, so I shall refrain."

units.source_text: 正在此时，太君派人送信来了。

en.t: Just then, the lady sent a messenger with a letter.

units.source_text: 信中说：“今日六条院大臣来此问病。

en.t: The letter said, "Today the minister of Rokujo-in has come here to inquire after my health.

units.source_text: 此间仆从稀少，设备简陋，深恐屈辱贵宾。

en.t: There are few servants here, and the furnishings are poor, so I deeply fear that we may dishonor our noble guest.

units.source_text: 务望即刻来此，但勿言接我通报。

en.t: Please come here at once, but do not say that you received word from me.

units.source_text: 见面之后，有要事相告云。”

en.t: After we meet, I have an important matter to tell you."

units.source_text: 内大臣想：“什么要事呢？

en.t: The Inner Minister thought, "What important matter could it be?

units.source_text: 想必是为了云居雁之事，夕雾向他们哭诉吧。”

en.t: It must be that Yugiri has gone to them weeping and complaining about Kumoi no Kari."

units.source_text: 又想：“太君年迈，在世之日无多了。

en.t: Then he thought, "The lady is old, and she has few days left in this world.

units.source_text: 她屡次劝我玉成此事。

en.t: She has urged me many times to bring this matter to a favorable conclusion.

units.source_text: 如果源氏肯出一言，善意相恳，我倒不好意思拒绝了。

en.t: If Genji were willing to say a word and kindly plead with me, I would feel ashamed to refuse.

units.source_text: 只是夕雾冷酷无言，教我看了很不快意。

en.t: Only Yugiri's cold silence is very displeasing for me to see.

units.source_text: 今后倘有适当机会，我就装作遵命的样子，允许了他们吧。”

en.t: If a suitable opportunity arises from now on, I shall pretend to obey their wishes and permit the two of them."

units.source_text: 他推想源氏与太君二人同心，合力相劝，那时更不好意思拒绝了。

en.t: He imagined that Genji and the lady would join their hearts and urge him together, and then it would be even harder for him to refuse.

units.source_text: 然而又想回来：“哪里！岂有让步之理！”

en.t: But then he reconsidered: "No! What reason is there for me to yield?"

units.source_text: 如此忽然变卦，可见他的性情异常顽固。

en.t: This sudden change of mind showed how extraordinarily stubborn his nature was.

units.source_text: 终于他想：“不过太君已有信来，源氏太政大臣正在等候我去会面。

en.t: At last he thought, "Still, the lady has already sent a letter, and Genji, the Chancellor, is waiting for me to come and meet him.

units.source_text: 我若不去，两方都对不起。

en.t: If I do not go, I will be at fault toward both sides.

units.source_text: 我且前往，察看情况，随机应变吧。”

en.t: For now I shall go there, observe the situation, and respond as circumstances require."

units.source_text: 他想定了，便把衣服穿得特别讲究，吩咐随从人等不可大肆声张，径向三条邸而去。

en.t: Having made up his mind, he dressed with special care, ordered his attendants not to make a great commotion, and went straight to the Sanjo mansion.
